description: This Java class 'AcknowledgementRequests' provides static factory methods for creating and parsing acknowledgment request objects, including deserialization from JSON and parsing from character sequences. It is a container class for handling acknowledgment request creation and parsing logic within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequests
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create, deserialize, and parse acknowledgment request objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest with the given label.

methods.name: newFilteredAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableFilteredAcknowledgementRequest with specified includes and optional filter.

methods.name: filteredAcknowledgementRequestFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into a FilteredAcknowledgementRequest.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into an ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest, throwing exceptions if parsing fails.
